note: Step-1a baseline of the critic-loop-cost design (see ai/docs/critic-loop-cost-design.md, as amended by the 2026-09-21 08:00Z architect consult; it was promoted there from the gitignored ai-artifacts/shipwright/pending/ copy in the same run that recorded this baseline, so the pending path this line used to cite is now only a pointer). This is the FROZEN CORE: fixtures 01-07 are never edited by the later steps, so their inputs are byte-identical at every measurement and theirs is the only series comparable across steps. Capability fixtures (08-11) are authored at the step that first makes their prompt input expressible and are NOT part of this series — before that step their value is undefined, recorded n/a, never 0. As of step 1b that is ENFORCED rather than remembered: a fixture declaring a `requires=` input absent from CriticPrompt::INPUTS makes `critic-eval --run` refuse to score and print no row at all, so the n/a cannot silently become a 0. A mixed-corpus aggregate is not a cross-step comparison and is only meaningful beside its corpus membership, which is why `corpus` is recorded here: the 2026-09-19 line read `recall 1.0 / precision 1.0` and would read identically over 11 fixtures while meaning something else. Three runs, not one, because the judge is stochastic: with 4 bad fixtures a single sampled miss moves aggregate recall 1.0 -> 0.75, below the trust bar, from noise alone — and run 1 here did produce precision 0.8 from a single false positive that did not recur. Re-baseline with the same command, N=3, after any rubric, prompt or fixture change.
